label: TMUA 2021 · Paper 2 · Question 15

hints.title: Use the axis equation
hints.body: A point on the y-axis has x=0. Substitute that into the circle equation.
hints.recap: Tangency to an axis is an intersection question.
hints.pitfall: Setting <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> would test the x-axis instead.
hints.pause: Write the resulting quadratic in y.

recall.reminder: Every point on the y-axis has <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math>; substitute that line equation to locate its intersections with the curve.

hints.title: Translate tangency
hints.body: The resulting equation is y2+by+c=0. One point of contact means a repeated root.
hints.pitfall: A nonnegative discriminant also allows two crossings.
hints.pause: Calculate the discriminant of this quadratic.

recall.reminder: A repeated quadratic root corresponds to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>D</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math>.

hints.title: Check the geometric converse
hints.body: Complete squares in the circle equation. Apply your zero-discriminant condition to its radius squared, and compare the radius with the centre’s distance from the y-axis.
hints.recap: A necessary-and-sufficient condition must also guarantee genuine tangency.
hints.pitfall: Use an absolute value for a distance, and use the given nonzero coefficient condition.
hints.pause: Verify the converse and select the equivalent algebraic condition.

recall.reminder: A necessary-and-sufficient condition must also guarantee genuine tangency.

solution:
At the y-axis, x=0, so common points satisfy y2+by+c=0. Tangency occurs exactly when this equation has one repeated root: b2−4c=0.

This condition is sufficient as well. Completing squares gives centre (−a2, −b2) and radius squared a2+b24−c=a24. Since a≠0, the radius is |a|2, equal to the centre’s distance from the y-axis.

b2=4c: B.
knowledgePattern: Set the y-axis intersection discriminant to zero
